research_question: How should a legal/evidentiary system analyse a shared transformer failure where some affected customers are compliant and others are alleged to be in arrears, tampering or illegally connected?

observations.statement: A shared distribution transformer is reported failed and multiple households are without supply.
Some households are reported compliant while other households are alleged to have payment or connection contraventions.
A local statement is reported to link restoration to payment or regularisation by non-compliant households.

required_analysis: identify the distributor and infrastructure owner
separate compliant and non-compliant customer positions
separate shared infrastructure obligations from individual debt or tamper enforcement
test genuine safety and technical explanations
verify the actual institutional reason for withholding restoration
retrieve current primary legal authority and later treatment
identify competent regulatory and court routes
preserve uncertainty where primary proof is missing
required_hypothesis_families: local communication not representing institutional decision
mutation_dimensions: payment condition supported only by hearsay
